omitted_tabs.reason: MySQL has server/session variables, not database-scoped parameter settings.

gaps.reason: Native database grants use the dedicated privilege operations. Applying a Security-tab diff remains the cross-operation part of Decision9.

fields.label: Default encryption
fields.help: Changes the native default for new tables; it does not encrypt existing table data. Native keyring/privilege requirements apply.

fields.label: Read only
fields.help: Native ALTER DATABASE only. State comes from SHOW CREATE DATABASE; unavailable observation remains unset.

notes: The six declared fields are verified on native MySQL9.7 through shared record/draft projections, pure/C plan/apply/reinspection, authenticated APIs and the unchanged shared family-render suite. Backend endpoint/visual fields load from this descriptor; old engine-specific field tuples are removed. Security diff dispatch remains Decision9. Human presentation and cross-platform acceptance remain separately owned.
